source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 2, 8. Πενθεῖ δὲ τεῖχος καὶ προτείχισμα, τὰ πένθους ἄξια, τοῦ κλαίειν καὶ τοῖς ὁρῶσιν αἴτια γινόμενα· «τὴν γὰρ βουλὴν κυρίου τίς διασκεδάσει; καὶ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ τὴν ὑψηλὴν τίς ἀποστρέψει ;« κατὰ τὸν μακάριον Ἡσαΐαν. τὴν δὲ τοιαῦτα πενθοῦσαν εἲτε πόλιν εἴτε ψυχὴν ὡς εἶναι τοῖς ἐχθροῖς καταπάτημα, πενθεῖν εἰκὸς ἀγγἐλους τοὺς πρότερον αὐτὴν ἄλλους ἐπ' ἄλλοις φυλάττοντας, μείχους τε καὶ ὑποβεβηκότας. εἰ γάρ ἐπὶ σωθεῖσι χαίρουσιν, ἐπὶ πεσοῦσι πῶς οὐ πενθήσουσιν;
pass_a_gloss: And teichos / wall and proteichisma / rampart mourn—things worthy of mourning, becoming causes of weeping also for those who see; for “who will scatter the counsel of the Lord? and who will turn back his high hand?” according to blessed Isaiah. And for such a city or soul mourning so as to be a trampling for the enemies, it is likely that angels mourn—those who formerly were guarding her, others upon others, both greater and subordinate. For if they rejoice over those saved, how will they not mourn over those who have fallen?
pass_b_english: And wall and rampart mourn—things worthy of mourning, becoming causes of weeping also for those who see; for “who will scatter the counsel of the Lord? and who will turn back his high hand?” (Lamentations 2:8) according to blessed Isaiah. And for such a city or soul mourning so as to be a trampling for the enemies, it is likely that angels mourn—those who formerly were guarding her, others upon others, both greater and subordinate. For if they rejoice over those saved, how will they not mourn over those who have fallen (Isaiah 14:27) (Luke 15:10)?

choices.why: Lam 2:19 night-watch askesis; Origen joins Mark 13 watches.
